t: You are outside Freemasons' Hall on Great Queen Street, between Holborn and Covent Garden. It is the headquarters of the United Grand Lodge of England and the Supreme Grand Chapter of Royal Arch Masons of England. Many Masonic lodges in the London area also meet here. The site has been a Masonic meeting place since 1775. Thomas Sandby designed it. He was an English draughtsman, watercolour artist, architect and teacher, and he was also private secretary to the Duke of Cumberland, who made him Deputy Ranger of Windsor Great Park.
